description: Prediction Market Analyzer — Independent probability that a Polymarket or Kalshi market resolves Yes, checked against the live book. Pass a market (slug, URL, conditionId or Kalshi ticker) and/or news text: the agent reads the rules, end date and best asks, estimates 0-100 with live web search (falling back to model knowledge if search is slow), and returns verdict.action BUY_YES / BUY_NO / NO_TRADE with edge in bps after tak

bankrollUsd.description: Converts the quarter-Kelly fraction into verdict.size_usd.

market.description: Polymarket slug, market URL or conditionId, or a Kalshi ticker or URL. Reads the question, rules, end date and live best asks; marketPriceYes then defaults to the book mid. A resolved market returns its outcome without a model call.

marketPriceScale.description: Force the unit of marketPriceYes: percent (35 = 35%) or fraction (0.35 = 35%).

marketPriceYes.description: Current implied Yes probability, used to compute edge. Percent (0-100) by default; a value strictly between 0 and 1 is read as a 0-1 market price (Polymarket/Kalshi style) unless marketPriceScale says otherwise.

minEdgePct.description: Minimum edge after taker fees, in percentage points, before verdict.action is BUY_YES or BUY_NO (default 5). A low-confidence estimate never produces a BUY.

question.description: Exact market question; inferred when omitted (read from the market when market is given).

text.description: News excerpt or event description. Required unless market is given; with market, extra evidence you want weighed.

name: market-predictor
